title: Miami Mountain Biking in Virginia Key Trails
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience unparalleled convenience, and we’re conveniently located a stone’s throw away from Miami’s mountain bike trails where you can enjoy unparalleled views of Miami and Biscayne Bay, ensuring an unmatched adventure! When you arrive to our shop you'll be greeted by the PADL team and fit to a bike. We provide a helmet with every rental and will size you with the correct bike. We will provide you with 
 a trail map onsite and if you have any questions, someone from our team will be happy to help. The trails are right next to our shop, so once your set up with your bike and helmet, just head on down!
